criteria_outcomes.criterion: map exact handoff needs to direct capability coverage

reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage preserves the eight allowed records and correctly marks exact need/capability matches as direct while leaving n06-r01 and n06-r07 unsupported. No behavioral fault is visible at this boundary.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: rank unsupported needs before covered needs
preserve upstream provenance rank within each group
support recommendation with observed unmet demand rather than covered keyword matches

reviews.decision_reason: prioritize_needs inverts the unsupported flag: rows with coverage == direct are marked unsupported true, while genuinely unsupported rows are marked false. This is behaviorally significant because it ranks already-covered needs ahead of uncovered needs and drives the final recommendation to prioritize a covered handoff need.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: construct recommendation from first priority record

reviews.decision_reason: synthesize_recommendation retains the eight-item priority window and constructs the recommendation from the first already-ranked priority. The bad recommendation is downstream of the inverted unsupported flag from prioritize_needs, not caused here.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: prove real customer demand from observed jobs, pain, triggers, alternatives, consequences, and outcomes

reviews.decision_reason: select_demand_records preserves all supplied corpus rows that meet the explicit demand_score threshold or fallback rule. No unrelated candidate selection is visible in the supplied package.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: normalize selected evidence to allowed-record window
avoid inventing demand evidence when context omits it

reviews.decision_reason: normalize_evidence keeps the bounded allowed-record window, applies JSON-safe defaults, and preserves the eight normalized need records used by the downstream handoff. No contradictory normalization behavior is visible.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: avoid treating repeated history as independent corroboration

reviews.decision_reason: assemble_provenance builds ranked provenance from normalized needs and preserves source identifiers and weights in demand-score order. The downstream fault is not traceable to this upstream provenance assembly.
